checkpoint.purpose: SKU gates v7 (au_side_only primary, option-list alignment, reason codes): freeze records, input/prediction manifests, invariants and evaluation for the 29 confirmed pairs; family-mapped exploration run v7 (not confirmed, no labels) with freeze, manifests and invariants only. Prediction files are not included; family predictions stay hidden until family labels exist.
checkpoint.extract_at: repository root; preserve .lab-output relative paths; use unzip -n
checkpoint.label_derived_content: evaluation/summary.json holds aggregate metrics, reason-code tables against the Luna v3 machine labels and the 37 gold-review rows with Luna rationales; evaluation/disagreements.jsonl holds gold decision, rows and rationale where A/B or their forced variants disagree with gold. Family files contain no label content. Raw labels.jsonl is not included.
